violations.text:
Floor tiles missing and/or in disrepair.
Cracked tiles next to fryers

No handwashing sign provided at a hand sink used by food employees.
At back hand sink next to walk in

Nonfood-contact surface soiled with grease, food debris, dirt, slime or dust.
Mop sink drain soiled
Water draining onto floor surface from PVC pipe under 3 bay sink

1 Live, small flying insects found near bread racks.
1 live fly near mop sink. 1 fly was killed.

Equipment in poor repair.
Gasket torn on reach in freezer
Manager has gasket ordered

Exterior door has a gap at the threshold that opens to the outside.
Back door gasket is loose allowing a gap to exterior
Ice buildup in walk-in freezer on condenser

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Liquid eggs observed at 59f sitting out for less than an hour. Manager moved to freezer to rapid chill

No soap provided at handwash sink.
Soap dispenser is broken at 3 bay sink. Manager has replacement and states she will fix today
